description.short: The Big Blue Experience is a watersports school and hire centre operating on Newgale Beach in the Pembrokeshire Coast National Park. Established in 2001, they offer kitesurfing, surfing, stand-up paddleboarding, coasteering, and equipment hire for all abilities, from complete beginners to advanced riders.
description.shortNote: Drafted from verified website and tourism listing content. Needs editorial review before publishing.
description.full:
The Big Blue Experience was established in 2001 at Newgale Beach in Pembrokeshire, Wales. Located within the Pembrokeshire Coast National Park, Big Blue is a comprehensive adventure and watersports centre offering a wide range of courses, lessons, and experiences for individuals, families, and groups from beginners to the more advanced.

Activities include kitesurfing (beginner through to wave riding and jumping), kite landboarding, power kiting, surfing, bodyboarding, stand-up paddleboarding (SUP), coasteering, and RYA powerboating. The centre also runs a Kids Club and multi-day adventure holiday packages covering combinations of surfing, SUP, kitesurfing, and mixed activities. Wetsuits, surfboards, kayaks, SUPs, and kitesurfing equipment are available for hire.

Big Blue is accredited by the British Kite Surfing Association (BKSA), the Academy of Surfing Instructors (ASI), the Royal Yachting Association (RYA), and Surf Life Saving Great Britain (SLSGB), and is a member of the Pembrokeshire Outdoor Charter and the International Kiteboarding Organisation (IKO). Instructor training courses in surfing, SUP, kitesurfing, bodyboarding, and beach lifeguarding are available on site.

The centre operates seasonally: June to September on the beach 9am–6pm; April to June and September to December 10am–5pm; closed January to April.
